name: The Ruins
tagline: Seven proven complexes. No myth, no mercy — just the work.
introText: Beyond the Wilds lie seven tests drawn from real iron, not legend. No narrative arc ties them together — only the weight in your hands and the clock on the wall.
completionText: The Ruins are done. Every one of the seven — The Sovereign, The Colossus, The Dualist, The Fallen, The Two-Faced, The Unbroken, and The Judge — has fallen to the same complexes that were tested and proven long before they had names.

territoryLore.theTerritory: Something stood here once — a structure, a system, a plan. All that's left is the weight of it, waiting to be lifted again.
territoryLore.whatDwellsHere: Machines that outlived their makers. Champions who never stopped training after there was anything left to defend. Power with nowhere left to go.
territoryLore.huntersPurpose: You come here to take back what was built and abandoned — one complex at a time, proven the same way it always was, no myth required.
territoryLore.transition: The iron doesn't know it's a ruin. Pick up where it left off.
